notes: The programme is taught in Indonesia (ITS Surabaya and Polimarin Semarang), with one compulsory semester in Germany. The DAAD page states that the application is via e-mail, not through uni-assist; however, the application page for the Faculty of Engineering states that for some degree programmes you must apply via uni-assist. It is not program-specific, so the application channel could not be determined.

note.fr: Vérifiez les conditions d'admission : diplôme d'études secondaires reconnu par l'Indonésie et le Mecklembourg-Poméranie occidentale (Allemagne), ou Diplôme-III avec une moyenne de 2,75 ou mieux (sur une échelle de quatre points), ou réussite d'une formation professionnelle et au moins trois ans de pratique professionnelle, ou réussite à un examen d'admission.
note.en: Check the admission requirements: high school diploma recognized by Indonesia and Mecklenburg-West Pomerania (Germany), or Diploma-III with a GPA of 2.75 or better (on a four-point scale), or successful completion of professional training and at least three years of working practice, or successful admission examination.

evidence.quote: A diploma from a senior high school or equivalent as acknowledged by the governments of Indonesia and Mecklenburg-West Pomerania (Germany) or Diploma-III graduate with NAME background and GPA of 2.75 or better (on a four-point scale) or Successful completion of professional training and at least three years of working practice Successful admission examination
